key.name: clipboard-monitor
key.description: Monitor PRIMARY selection for word lookup.

key.name: app-filter
key.description: Comma-separated list of App IDs to filter. Empty means allow all.

key.name: hover-monitor
key.description: Hover over a word to translate automatically via OCR.

key.name: hover-delay
key.description: Milliseconds before triggering translation after mouse stops.

key.name: hover-modifier
key.description: Modifier key required for hover: 'none', 'Ctrl', 'Alt', 'Shift', or 'Super'.

key.name: debug-save-capture
key.description: Save each OCR capture PNG to /tmp/quickdict-ocr for inspection.

key.name: debug-log
key.description: Print OCR lookup progress logs (captured region, result counts) to the journal.
